correctness.rationale: Mycielski edges give A:(B,Bprime), Aprime:(B,w), B:(A,Aprime), Bprime:(A,w), w:(Aprime,Bprime). For class counts x=(p,q,r,s,z), each unselected class is dominated iff an adjacent class count is positive. Exchanging one guard of an adjacent class yields exactly the same occupancy security test as original vertex-by-vertex quantifiers because each class consists of true neighborhood twins. With <=5 guards and a,b>=4 any nonapex occupancy >=4 is impossible; z=0 forces p=r=2 and q+s=1; z=1 forces p,r>=1, both p+q,r+s>=2, except the single boundary fill case p=3,a=4 or r=3,b=4. The budget forces the four ordinary apex profiles and two boundary profiles, and direct substitution proves all surviving exchanges. Each pattern yields the binomial labelled count. A separately written original-graph adjacency/bitset enumerator checked ALL subsets of size 0..5 at seven parameter pairs (4,4),(4,5),(5,4),(5,5),(4,6),(6,4),(5,6), finding no sub-five secure sets, exactly 6/7/8 expected profiles and total counts 804,1330,1330,2225,2046,2046,3435; finite checks corroborate, not replace, the unlimited proof.

value.rationale: The object is a natural graph operator applied to a classical two-parameter extremal family, and the invariant is the complete set of optimal one-move-defensible guard placements. The result resolves a genuine structural classification absent from the known scalar optimum gamma_s=5: six general profile types, two exact shore-size-four exceptions, and exact labelled multiplicities for the full infinite a,b>=4 regime. The count quantifies redundancy and boundary effects not derivable from one optimum witness. It neither relies solely on a verifier nor claims a paper-sized downstream theorem.

final_claim.original_scope: For ordinary Mycielskians of K_{a,b}, all integers a,b>=4, exact five-class occupancy classification of every size-five secure dominating set: six unconditional profiles and size-four shore exceptional profiles; exact labelled count M(a,b) and gamma_s=5, the latter already known.
final_claim.reason: The exact five-class criterion, all eight profiles and binomial count survive, no new research-file edit needed. The earlier minimum-size theorem is expressly credited; originality attaches to the complete minimizer classification and labelled census, qualified by accessible-literature limitations.
